## Singapore museum itinerary — 19–20 September 2026  
**Time zone:** Asia/Singapore

### Saturday, 19 September — National Museum of Singapore
- **10:30–13:30:** Explore *Singapore Odyssea* and *Once Upon a Tide* at an unhurried pace.
- **Note:** The Singapore History Gallery remains closed for renovation until 10 October 2026.
- **Transit:** Take the Circle Line to **Bras Basah MRT**, then walk about four minutes. Museum hours are listed as **10:00–19:00**; recheck before departure.

### Sunday, 20 September — National Gallery Singapore
- **11:00–14:30:** Focus on Singaporean art, then pause for lunch or coffee inside.
- **Note:** The UOB Southeast Asia Gallery is temporarily closed, although National Collection works remain elsewhere.
- **Transit:** Take the MRT to **City Hall, Exit B**, then walk roughly seven minutes. Listed hours: **10:00–19:00**, last admission 18:30.

### Weather caveat
No verified forecast covering **both exact dates** was available. The official MSS outlook issued **1 September 2026** covers only the **first fortnight (1–15 September)**, not your visit.  
**Seasonal guidance—not a dated forecast:** historical-data guidance suggests September is hot, humid and prone to rain. Carry water and a compact umbrella, and check MSS shortly before travel.

**Sources**
- National Museum: https://www.nationalmuseum.nhb.gov.sg/index  
- National Gallery visitor information: https://www.nationalgallery.sg/plan-your-visit  
- National Gallery transport guide: https://www.nationalgallery.sg/sg/en/the-gallery-edit/visitor-guide-where-to-go-in-singapore.html  
- MSS outlook, issued 1 September: https://www.weather.gov.sg/fwo-dry-conditions-to-continue-into-the-first-fortnight-of-september-2026/  
- Historical-data weather guidance: https://www.easeweather.com/asia/singapore/september
